record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> <FI>or<Fi> Song<WH07892> for the sabbath<WH07676> day<WH03117>.<Fo><Fo> <FI>It is a<Fi> good<WH02896> <FI>thing<Fi> to give thanks<WH03034><WTH8687> unto the LORD<WH03068>, and to sing praises<WH02167><WTH8763> unto thy name<WH08034>, O most High<WH05945>:
To shew forth<WH05046><WTH8687> thy lovingkindness<WH02617> in the morning<WH01242>, and thy faithfulness<WH0530> every night<WH03915>, <RF>every...: Heb. in the nights<Rf>

Upon an instrument of ten strings<WH06218>, and upon the psaltery<WH05035>; upon the harp<WH03658> with a solemn sound<WH01902>. <RF>the harp...: or, the solemn sound with the harp<Rf> <RF>a solemn...: Heb. Higgaion<Rf>
For thou, LORD<WH03068>, hast made me glad<WH08055><WTH8765> through thy work<WH06467>: I will triumph<WH07442><WTH8762> in the works<WH04639> of thy hands<WH03027>.
O LORD<WH03068>, how great<WH01431><WTH8804> are thy works<WH04639>! <FI>and<Fi> thy thoughts<WH04284> are very<WH03966> deep<WH06009><WTH8804>.
A brutish<WH01198> man<WH0376> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8799> not; neither doth a fool<WH03684> understand<WH0995><WTH8799> this.<CM>

When the wicked<WH07563> spring<WH06524><WTH8800> as the grass<WH06212>, and when all the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205> do flourish<WH06692><WTH8686>; <FI>it is<Fi> that they shall be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8736> for ever<WH05703>:
But thou, LORD<WH03068>, <FI>art most<Fi> high<WH04791> for evermore<WH05769>.

For, lo, thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, O LORD<WH03068>, for, lo, thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> shall perish<WH06><WTH8799>; all the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205> shall be scattered<WH06504><WTH8691>.
But my horn<WH07161> shalt thou exalt<WH07311><WTH8686> like <FI>the horn of<Fi> an unicorn<WH07214>: I shall be anointed<WH01101><WTH8804> with fresh<WH07488> oil<WH08081>.

Mine eye<WH05869> also shall see<WH05027><WTH8686> <FI>my desire<Fi> on mine enemies<WH07790>, <FI>and<Fi> mine ears<WH0241> shall hear<WH08085><WTH8799> <FI>my desire<Fi> of the wicked<WH07489><WTH8688> that rise up<WH06965><WTH8801> against me.
The righteous<WH06662> shall flourish<WH06524><WTH8799> like the palm tree<WH08558>: he shall grow<WH07685><WTH8799> like a cedar<WH0730> in Lebanon<WH03844>.
Those that be planted<WH08362><WTH8803> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> shall flourish<WH06524><WTH8686> in the courts<WH02691> of our God<WH0430>.
They shall still bring forth fruit<WH05107><WTH8799> in old age<WH07872>; they shall be fat<WH01879> and flourishing<WH07488>; <RF>flourishing: Heb. green<Rf>
To shew<WH05046><WTH8687> that the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> upright<WH03477>: <FI>he is<Fi> my rock<WH06697>, and <FI>there is<Fi> no unrighteousness<WH05766><WTH8675><WH05766> in him.<CM>
